written.headline: NCERT releases 20-hour AI and computational thinking module for classes 9-12
written.summary: The National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT) has launched a 20-hour introductory module on computational thinking and artificial intelligence for students in classes 9 to 12. Developed with IIT Madras and IIT Jodhpur, the activity-based curriculum covers machine learning, deepfake detection, data privacy and ethical AI use.
